physicalNotes: Radius 0.18824192 Jupiter radii from González-Álvarez et al. 2022 (2022A&A...658A.138G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A.138G/abstract): 13,457.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.02617765 Jupiter masses (González-Álvarez et al. 2022, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2022A&A...658A.138G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A.138G/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
